notes.title: Support us on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! As you know, Ballads at Midnight is completely free, so if you want to support the team behind we are currently [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/367138901/imperial-grace-a-medieval-otome-visual-novel]running a Kickstater campaign for Imperial Grace[/url], a game made by the same direct and lead artist. Also, our trailer is voiced by the delicious Eric Navarro (Lucius voice actor) check it out <3

[previewyoutube=LpaHlBWXFUI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]There are only three days left to complete the final stretch goals[/b] so don't delay! Also, if you can’t support financially but still want to spread the word, we have some cool community goals! Every post count! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42455891/d24e8bc8f9efae0c5133d4e7ad8286fbefe43384.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1652580/Imperial_Grace/


[h3]I also encourage you to check out the work of the other members of the team if you haven’t already: [/h3]

- [url=https://music.apple.com/us/album/ballads-at-midnight-original-soundtrack/1621564378]Download the soundtrack of the game on any music store.[/url]
- Play [url=https://wudgeous.itch.io/herotome]Herotome[/url] (Demo on itchio), the main game of our lead writer, Wudge.
- Play [url=https://pdrr.itch.io/perfumare]Perfumare[/url] (itchio) another super cool game proofread by the wonderful Jen
- Play the lovely [url=https://kiminako.itch.io/where-are-you-cinderella/devlog/284679/where-are-you-cinderella-version-franaise]Where are you Cinderella[/url] (demo on itchio), by Kimi, our trailer maker.


Anyway, thank you so much for all the love you have showed to Ballads at Midnight so far, I can't believe after less than a year [b]we have 240 reviews, and more than 50 000 downloads[/b]!!! THANK YOU! 

It’s unlikely the game will ever receive any update because the original team is busy with others project, but I want to celebrate the first years anniversary,[b] so I am planning some surprise for the 15th July, stay tuned! [/b]

Take care, 
Ayael
